skills.name: High-Speed Evolution
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when landing a normal attack. Affects the target. Deals 1.9% of final ATK as additional damage. ■ Activates after landing 200 normal attacks. Affects self. Critical Damage ▲ 9.93%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 10 sec. Max Ammunition Capacity ▼ 5.04%. Stacks up to 5 times and lasts for 10 sec.

skills.name: Giant Leap
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Activates when entering Full Burst. Affects all allies. Hit Rate ▲ 5.35% for 15 sec. ■ Activates after landing 200 normal attacks while the skill user's hit rate is increased. Affects self. ATK ▲ 18.36% for 10 sec.

skills.name: New World
skills.summary: Lv1: ■ Affects all allies. Full Burst Duration ▲ 5 sec. ■ Affects self. Unlimited ammunition for 15 sec. Destroy Mode: Extends her line of sight and auto-aims at all enemies within range. The stage target is treated as a single enemy regardless of whether it has parts (including interruption parts). Deals 1.52% of final ATK as damage for 15 sec.
